propositions: Structured-output validation and recovery must execute through a single Pydantic Agent operation with a shared request budget, replacing split bespoke retry orchestration and Pydantic AI authority
Retry context must preserve complete failed responses when they fit the budget and omit them entirely when oversize, never truncating authoritative input, accepted output, or stored history
Rebar must preserve deterministic extraction, fallback eligibility, terminal refusal/filter behavior, typed exhaustion, and provenance across the Pydantic-native operation
Pydantic run usage must be reported exactly once for successful operations while fallback/downgrade candidates remain trace or journal events, not competing usage counters
The bespoke structured-output retry loop must be removed only after compatibility suite and Anthropic/Bedrock cache canaries pass, with source census and live evidence recorded
